report_metadata.title: Polarix Maitri ML Scenario Validation and Final Evaluation Report

scenarios.description: Stationary baseline telemetry with normal diurnal variation across 30 consecutive observations.
scenarios.expected_behavior: First 29 steps return INSUFFICIENT_DATA; 30th step executes scored LSTM inference producing NORMAL status with MSE <= threshold.
scenarios.observed_behavior: Step 30 scored successfully with status=NORMAL, type=NORMAL, score=0.001435.

scenarios.description: Sudden high-magnitude step jump (+40°C thermal excursion) arriving on active sensor history.
scenarios.expected_behavior: LSTM reconstruction error sharply exceeds threshold, triggering ANOMALY status and SPIKE anomaly-type classification.
scenarios.observed_behavior: Anomaly detected with score=4.945585 (> threshold 0.017674), classified as SPIKE.

scenarios.description: Sustained linear monotonic ramp across the 30-step window (gradual barometric drift).
scenarios.expected_behavior: LSTM sequence autoencoder identifies cumulative directional shift, flagging ANOMALY and DRIFT/UNKNOWN category.

scenarios.description: Sensor flatline failure with 15 consecutive identical observations (zero local variance).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Contract processes successfully; physical classifier evaluates flatline features. Scored reconstruction or flatline classification behavior documented factually.

scenarios.description: Telemetry dropout event where sensor value is null/unavailable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Inference returns MISSING_DATA with null score and type, immediately clearing the sensor rolling buffer.

scenarios.description: Incoming telemetry on sensor with fewer than 30 observations (< sequence length).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null anomaly score and type, safely accumulating buffer.

scenarios.description: Telemetry tagged with non-GOOD telemetry quality flag (BAD / UNCERTAIN).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Follows missing-data semantics, returning MISSING_DATA and flushing rolling buffer.

scenarios.description: Non-finite floating point observation (NaN or +/- Infinity) injected into pipeline.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Intercepted before neural network tensors; safely routed to MISSING_DATA with cleared buffer.

scenarios.description: Duplicate observation with identical (station_id, sensor_id, timestamp) arriving twice.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Raises DuplicateTelemetryError; does not duplicate buffer entries or advance window.

scenarios.description: Out-of-order telemetry arriving with a timestamp older than the most recently recorded timestamp.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Raises StaleTelemetryError; preserves chronological sequence without history corruption.

scenarios.description: Concurrent interleaved telemetry stream across TEMP_001, PRESS_001, and VIB_001.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each sensor maintains an isolated rolling deque; multi-sensor records do not cross-contaminate history.
scenarios.observed_behavior: TEMP_001 buffer=30, PRESS_001 buffer=30, VIB_001 buffer=30, POWER_001 buffer=0.

comparative_observations: Z-score baseline exhibits high precision (0.71) and low false alarm rate (1.44%), but misses gradual drift anomalies (2.67% recall) due to rolling mean adaptation.
LSTM Autoencoder achieves significantly higher recall (52.60%) on temporal sequences (Spike: 100%, Drift: 84.67%), but incurs a higher false positive rate (48.15%) on normal diurnal fluctuations.
Neither single-threshold statistical nor autoencoder loss reliably detects mid-range flatlines (STUCK_VALUE: 0-5%) without dedicated variance-based heuristic classification.
Model choice involves an operational trade-off between false alarm suppression and early anomaly sensitivity on this synthetic dataset.

limitations.synthetic_data_only: All evaluations are conducted exclusively on synthetic telemetry. No real Antarctic sensor telemetry was available or used.
limitations.no_field_operational_claims: Metrics demonstrate mathematical characteristics under synthetic workloads and do not constitute field deployment validation, production SLAs, or certified reliability.
limitations.frozen_threshold: The reconstruction threshold (0.017674) was selected strictly on the Validation split and evaluated on the untouched Test split.
limitations.real_world_transferability: Operational environmental noise, multi-sensor coupling, and unmodeled mechanical failure modes in real Antarctic operations may differ substantially from synthetic profiles.

integration_readiness.observability: VALIDATED (InferenceDiagnosticRecord, bounded latency tracking, status vocabulary)
integration_readiness.reliability_hardening: VALIDATED (NaN/Inf, missing data, duplicate timestamps, out-of-order rejection)
